name: Short Legs, Long Opinions
title: Unisex Dachshund – Short Legs, Long Opinions Socks
story: Short legs, long opinions: dachshund socks for the wiener dog owner whose dog has a take on everything, a stocking stuffer for the person who talks about their dachshund more than their job, wrapped for Christmas or a birthday.

The print is a red dachshund mid-trot with its ears flying and its tongue out, under SHORT LEGS, LONG OPINIONS in bold red slab capitals, on cream. The art matches our Short Legs, Long Opinions hoodie, so the socks make a set with the sweatshirt.

Anyone who lives with a dachshund knows the legs are short and the opinions are not: about dinner time, about the mailman, about whose spot on the couch it is. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy gift for the dachshund mom or dad who already owns a dog-shaped everything.
joke_a: Anyone who lives with a dachshund knows the legs are short and the opinions are not, about dinner, the mailman and whose spot on the couch it is. The Short Legs, Long Opinions Socks from Graphic Tees Co. put that dog on the leg with its ears flying, so the joke reads on a walk and on the couch.
